name: Brevo
summary: Email, SMS and CRM marketing platform.

flows.title: Create an email campaign
steps: Go to Marketing > Campaigns and click Create campaign, then choose Email.
Choose the type of campaign, such as Regular email campaign.
Name the campaign so you can find it in your list of email campaigns; this name is only visible to you.
Click Create campaign to open the setup page, where you choose the sender, recipients, subject line, and design.

flows.title: Import contacts
steps: Go to CRM > Contacts and click Import contacts. Make sure the Contacts card is selected and click Continue.

Choose an import option. With Upload a file, select the contact file or drag it into the outlined area, check the preview shows the contacts and their data separated correctly, and click Confirm your file. With Copy/Paste, paste the data with each contact on its own line and each item separated by a comma or a tab, click Check the data to see that same preview, and click Confirm your data.
Map the data to the matching attributes in the Brevo account, then click Confirm mapping.
On Select a list, choose the list or lists the contacts are added to, then click Confirm your list.

On Finalize your import, leave every setting off unless the user asked for it. Brevo warns that these settings may irreversibly overwrite existing data or blocklist the imported contacts: updating the attributes of existing contacts, importing empty fields that erase existing attribute data, and the blocklist toggles for Email, SMS and WhatsApp.
Check the I confirm that my new import adheres to these conditions box only when every contact has explicitly consented to receive these messages, then click Confirm your import.

flows.title: Create a contact list
steps: Name the list and choose which folder it belongs in.

flows.title: View a campaign's report
steps: Next to a sent campaign, click the report icon; for suspended, running, or archived campaigns, click More action, then Report.
The Overview tab opens by default and summarizes the campaign's key results.
Open the Deliverability, Opens, Clicks, Conversions, Revenue, or Unsubscribes tabs for more detailed data on each metric.
